thread:
marta: Heads-up: planning to lift runtime pin for 3.0 on canary at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. Observed a small cluster of SDK v1.5.0 clients that may not advertise the new KV header.
deploybot: [snapshot] pinlist @2027-02-14T12:20Z: runtime-3.0 -> PINNED (canary=true). 5 routes with SDK mismatch.
sam: Which routes? I want to run quick compat probes before we touch production.
marta: routes: embed-ingest, partner-playground, sandbox-eval. Low volume, but partner playground has stricter SLAs.
irene: Saw a handful of kvcache miss/fallback traces in eu-west last night. Example log: `kvcache: miss -> kernel_fallback; sdk: missing-header; conn-retry`.
sasha: Ops suggestion: add a lightweight routing guard that checks `X-KV-Protocol: v3` and `X-SDK: >=1.5.1` else route to runtime 2.19 for 24h. Minimal change and isolates non-compliant clients.
sam: I can cut an SDK patch 1.5.1 to ship the header; ETA 3h. But we shouldn't block unpin for that.
ops-bot: [action] propose soft-unpin @02:00 UTC with canary weight 10% -> ramp to 30% over 20m if metrics stable. Auto-rollback triggers: error-rate delta >0.035 OR p95 latency + >150ms (5m rolling).
marta: Add exclusions: nightly-batch jobs and internal-debug. Also tag telemetry with `runtime=3.0-guarded` for the first 6h.
sasha: I'll push the routing rule and the telemetry tag. Pseudocode: `if not headers['X-KV-Protocol']=='v3' or headers['X-SDK']<'1.5.1' then route(runtime='2.19')`.
sam: I'll publish SDK 1.5.1 immediately and ping partners.
marta: Final: soft-unpin 02:00 UTC with header-based guard, staged ramp, 5m rolling windows, per-route rollback. Support and partners will be notified. I'll post the brief release note in #support. :white_check_mark:
